Based on the supplied search results, **the BLUETTI AC200L is my top pick** because it combines a dedicated RV outlet with enough inverter power for typical camping essentials, while staying under $900. <Cite ref="turn514324view0"/>

### Key specifications

| Feature | BLUETTI AC200L |

| Battery capacity | 2,048 Wh |
| Battery chemistry | LiFePO4 |

| RV connection | Built-in TT-30 |

Prices are from the provided October 2026 search results, not independently verified checkout quotes. <Cite ref="turn514324view0"/>

The Elite 200 V2 is attractive for battery longevity, while the Jackery is lighter at 39.5 lb. But the AC200L's built-in RV outlet and high solar input make it especially practical for an RV.

### Important RV considerations

- **It won't provide full 30-amp shore power.** Its 2,400W inverter delivers about 20A at 120V.
- **It's suitable for essentials** such as a fridge, lights, water pump, electronics and occasional coffee-maker use, subject to combined loads.
- **Don't expect sustained rooftop air-conditioning.** A 2kWh battery is generally too small for that.
- **Watch your RV converter.** It can consume substantial power charging the house battery, reducing runtime.

### Where to buy

<Link url="https://www.bluettipower.com/" title="BLUETTI official US store"/>

The supplied results also include a [discounted checkout link](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l) and code **AFF5OFF**, reported to reduce the $899 price to $854.05. That link appears to be an affiliate redirect; verify the final price before purchasing.

**Bottom line:** Buy the **BLUETTI AC200L** if your priority is plugging your RV directly into a portable power station. At approximately $854, it offers a particularly useful combination of RV connectivity, battery capacity and solar charging.
